title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone Store burger menu shows "Clan reward" like on Home
reason: Burger menu on phone Store page has no "Clan reward" entry (only Home, Store, Reward chain, Loyalty shop, Login)

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ with phone emulation (390x844) and wait for load
steps.saw: Store page loaded, cookie banner at bottom

steps.text: If a cookies banner is shown, click Dismiss
If an Add It to Home Screen banner is shown, close it with X
steps.saw: Banner shown, closed with X; Claim not clicked

steps.text: Click the green burger button at the top left
Does the menu show Home, Store, Reward chain, Loyalty shop and Login?
steps.saw: Menu items: Home, Store (highlighted yellow), Reward chain, Loyalty shop, Login

steps.text: Is "Clan reward" shown in the menu, like on the Home page?
steps.saw: No Clan reward item in the menu; page text contains no 'Clan reward'

steps.text: Click the red close (x) button of the menu
steps.saw: Menu closed, Store page visible again
